# Weapons and Tools
Which tools you may use depends on the prey in front of you. See [textlink="Prey" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodePrey"] for how prey is classified.
## Against worthy prey
- All Yautja melee weapons. - Smart-discs and harpoons. When engaging a single target, use at most one of each, unless the target is dishonorable. - Hunting traps. - The non-lethal plasma caster, without stun-hitting (hitting prey while they're down and unable to resist). It should only be used when fighting more than one worthy prey.
## Against dishonorable and temporarily dishonorable prey
Everything above, plus: - The plasma rifle. - The plasma pistol. - Cloaked combat. - The spike launcher. - Multiple harpoons and multiple smart-discs. - The lethal and non-lethal plasma caster, with stun-hitting allowed. Use your own initiative here. - The hunting bow, explosive and non-explosive.
## Prey weaponry Weapons thrown at you can be thrown back, whether they were aimed at you and missed or you caught one mid-air. When a thrown explosive lands in a lodge you are in, you may also throw it outside or towards prey.
